assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and intermittent lightheadedness in the setting of known unspecified atrial fibrillation (I48.91).
The patient has a personal history of transient ischemic attack and cerebral infarction (Z86.73).
Prolonged cardiac rhythm monitoring is indicated to evaluate for arrhythmia burden and guide anticoagulation management.
CPT 93271 is distinct from other bundled procedures.
